page.overview:
Who is Axantur?

Axantur was a nobleman of Númenor of royal descent.

Axantur was the son of Nolondil (youngest son of the second King of Númenor, Vardamir Nólimon) and the cousin of King Tar-Elendil. He had two other siblings: Yávien and Oromendil. He married an unnamed woman and had three children named Lindissë, Ardamir, and Cemendur. Little of Axantur's life is known; but his descendants would enter into the ruling line, and his great-grandson Hallacar would marry Tar-Ancalimë, the first Ruling Queen of Númenor.
